items: 【Perfect Size & Great Value 10-Pack】 Comes with 10 pack half round plant support stakes (10" Wide x 24" High). This set is designed to provide ample support for your growing garden. Whether you have medium-sized indoor pots or tall outdoor bushes, our 10-piece value pack ensures you have enough stakes to organize your garden and keep pathways open.

【Sturdy & Weather-Resistant Material】 Crafted from high-quality steel with a premium green powder coating, these garden stakes are much sturdier than plastic or wood. They are rustproof, fade-resistant, and built to withstand heavy rain and strong winds. The 4mm thickness ensures they won't deform even when supporting heavy blooms like Peonies or Hydrangeas.

【Smart Half Round & Interlocking Design】 The innovative half-round design allows you to easily fit these stakes around your plants. Use them individually as a single support or link two or more together to create a circular cage or a long row border. The groove design makes interlinking effortless, providing a customized support system for your unique gardening needs.

【Natural Appearance & Invisible Support】 The dark green glossy surface allows the plant cages to blend seamlessly into your foliage, making them nearly invisible. They prop up your plants to grow straight and healthy without distracting from the natural beauty of your flowers. Perfect for both indoor potted plants like Monstera and outdoor flowers like Roses and Lilies.

【Easy to Use & Versatile Application】 No tools required! Simply push the stakes into the ground. They are detachable and stackable, saving space when not in use. Ideal for a wide range of plants: peonies, hydrangeas, roses, tomatoes, peppers, orchids, and more. Protect your plants from drooping or spreading out while maintaining an aesthetic garden appeal.
